title: Nutrició animal
author: Pedro Miguel Gómez
school: IES Guillem d'Alcalà La Pobla de Farnals (València) (Horta Nord)

description.en:
Project of activities about animal nutrition. The project deals with several concepts throughout the activities:
  • Autotrophic nutrition
  • Heterotrophic nutrition
  • Digestive apparatus
  • Circulatory apparatus
  • Respiratory apparatus
  • Excretion apparatus
